content: Common approach for sidebar-desktop / bottom-tab-tablet responsive nav: a single CSS Grid or Flex layout definition, with one media query breakpoint (commonly ~768-820px, matching this project's own demo breakpoint) that swaps grid-template-areas / flex-direction and toggles visibility between a fixed lateral sidebar and a fixed bottom tab bar, sharing the same list of nav items/icons so there is one source of truth for the menu. Avoid separate desktop/mobile component trees where possible; drive it from CSS plus a shared nav-items array to prevent drift between the two.
